book.preparation: Place the board in the middle of the table with the pieces where everyone can reach them. Each player chooses a colour and sets up their playing area. Leave some room for the cards and other pieces you will need during the game.
book.reference: Keep the manual near the board. When a question comes up, find the relevant section together, then carry on playing from where you left off.
book.turns: Before the first turn, go over the aim of the game and the actions you can take. If you are playing for the first time, try a practice round to get familiar with the rules.
